Implemented in the 2026-06-22 working tree; committed 2026-09-05 on cetec-structural-port after Biome, standards validator, Panda codegen and Storybook build passed. Typecheck outstanding at commit time. Not re-verified line by line against the spec.

Ported DS #173 (MenuItem checkbox/toggle controls are readOnly, aria-hidden, pointer-events none; handleControlChange removed) and DS #188 (ListItem rowId -> data-row-id, with a 'Row identifiers' story). Typecheck, Biome and standards pass.

Ported the intent, not the diff. okshaun's chip recipe has no buttonStyles block and no ancestor [data-*] selectors matching the DS's, so the :has() swap in DS 256b612a does not apply. Fixed the three selectors that carried the same leak: dismissButton now reads its own &[data-selected=true], and chipIcon reads a data-selected attribute Chip.tsx now sets on the check Icon, replacing two unbounded descendant selectors. Colors.ts token additions from the same DS PR deliberately excluded.

Ported Text definition tooltips and the underline restructure from DS 892ec731. Added the dashedUnderline variant, gave underline real thickness/offset/skip-ink metrics, and replaced linkBase's linear-gradient underline hack with a real text-decoration using okshaun's link and link.pressed tokens. Moved link _disabled out of linkVariants into linkBase: Link.tsx never passed a _disabled variant to the recipe, so disabled styling had never rendered. Tooltip no longer imports Text (Text now renders a Tooltip, which would have been an import cycle).

Ported the DS shadow refactor (e4f63f5f) with okshaun's own colors. Added shadowDefinitions, dropShadows and filterAutoValue; moved the shadow layer colors from primitives into semantics so each elevation needs one geometry instead of a light/dark pair; collapsed shadow primitives 15 to 6 and semantics to 5 flat names. Dropped the unused up variants and overlay.dark per Shaun's call. Kept overflow's wider dark blur as the one geometry that genuinely differs by mode.

Chip.tsx appends ' group' to the body slot's className, matching the idiom in Button, IconButton and FormField. The body is the interactive element and the ancestor of chipIcon, so all five .group rules now match. Note this is a visual change: the chipIcon hover and active fills had never rendered.

Registered as 'filter' rather than 'filtersProperty', extending Panda's base filter utility. filters.ts now exports a plain filterValues map (auto, invert, blur, none) consumed directly by the utility instead of pointing at a nonexistent token category, and filterAutoValue stays the single source for the composable slot string that dropShadow also writes through. Generated types now read filter: 'auto' | 'invert' | 'blur' | 'none', and the inert filtersProperty style prop is gone.

Adopted the Cetec DS structure at Shaun's direction. The container is now always rendered, is the root, and paints the pill; body is transparent and keeps typography, padding, focus ring and interactivity. Verified in Storybook: dismiss button sits inside the pill flush against body across sizes and slot combinations, and selected, disabled, loading and deleted all resolve on the container. Deliberate deviation from the DS: the dismiss button no longer paints a hover background, because bg.neutral tokens are semi-transparent (#1717170F over #17171724 composites to about 26 percent, not the 14 percent the token specifies). The icon fill carries the affordance instead. Also fixed borderRadius 'full' on dismissButton, which is not a radii token here and resolved to 0.

The light/dark switch moved back onto the shadow semantic token, which Panda re-declares under :where(.dark, [data-color-mode=dark]) and therefore resolves in the scoped subtree. Each elevation has a light and a dark primitive again, but both are still generated from ONE geometry definition, so the point of the refactor is kept. dropShadow keeps reading the semantic colour, which is correct because its var is declared on the using element. Verified in a browser against the generated CSS: inside a [data-color-mode=dark] subtree, raised resolves to rgba(1,4,4,0.5) and overflow keeps its wider 0.75rem dark blur, while the light panel resolves to rgba(30,31,33,0.25) and 0.5rem.

Resolved by adopting the Cetec recipes for card, listItem, chip, badge, textInput and button rather than only stripping compoundVariants, at Shaun's direction: those components are production-hardened and okshaun's own semantic tokens carry the styling. Also ported the two shared foundations the Cetec recipes depend on - globalBaseStyles and listDensity - and moved list and listItemGroup onto the same density abstraction. Every variant prop on all six recipes is now ConditionalValue. Two Cetec-only tokens failed silently and were handled: cta's gold palette (variant dropped, no okshaun equivalent) and text.selected.hovered (mapped to text.selected). tag still declares compoundVariants, and so does Cetec's tag, so it is left alone. Verified in Storybook: list and menu density unchanged at compact 10/3 and comfortable 12/7, textInput sizes 24/32/40/48, all eight button variants render.

Merged the alias and tag improvements from DS #197 into the 42 okshaun metadata files that needed them (32 were already equivalent), added the six new icons (cheese, collapse-vertical, expand-vertical, magnet, to-date-backward, to-date-forward) and regenerated the sprite. Merged by union with okshaun's entries first, so nothing okshaun defines was lost - okshaun's chevron-filled-* icons do not exist in Cetec and were untouched. Verified in Storybook: the catalog is 325 icons, up from 319; searching snooze finds alarm via a merged alias, magnet finds the new icon, and chevron still returns 16.

Ported the Cetec modal rebuild (#195 c329563d) and the floating-layer fix (#191 76a0a21c). ModalWrapper + ModalWrapperContext replace okshaun's Modal + ModalContext as the shell; new form Modal and ConfirmationModal added; modal recipe, 3 story files and index exports updated. zIndex gained 1102/modalFloating. Ported dsComponent, dsChain, dsPart and DsChainScope early because the modal files import them - ecl.6 still owns stamping the other components. Added @tanstack/react-form as an optional peer, following okshaun's own fonts convention rather than Cetec's non-optional peer. Verified in a static Storybook build: dialog 1101, menu wrapper 1102, dropdown renders above the modal panel; form Modal opens with its field and footer. Two gaps found only by rendering: Menu/SubMenu/Select needed wiring to useFloatingLayer, and panda.config staticCss needed the menu layer variant because the value is chosen at runtime.

Replaced DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker and TimeRangePicker with the Cetec DateTime family (helpers, inputs, menus, pickers), Calendar and SegmentedInputs, plus six recipes (calendar, dateMenus, timeMenus, dateTimeMenus, segmentedInputs, segmentedFields) and the matching staticCss entries. Old component dirs and the datePicker/timePicker recipes deleted per Shaun's clean-break decision; the names DatePicker, TimePicker etc. still export, but from components/DateTime, exactly as Cetec does. Ported SlotOwner into SlotContext, keeping okshaun's stricter ColorToken fill. Rewrote ~/utils/useControllableState to okshaun's ~/system/hooks path. Verified in a static Storybook build: Calendar renders with okshaun's chevrons, and ArrowDown from a DatePicker segment opens the calendar popover positioned under the input. 20 Biome errors came across with the Cetec code, which lints with ESLint: two story exports named Date shadowed the global and were renamed, and the rest are ARIA-role and hook-dependency patterns now carried as biome-ignore directives with reasons.
